clip.failed: Couldn't clip the page: {message}. Copy the part you want and use "Clip from clipboard".
clip.flagged: {count} hidden or instruction-like passage(s) on the page were marked in the note — they are not instructions.
clip.localOnly: Under the local-only policy Lumen does not fetch web pages. Copy the page in your browser and use “Clip from clipboard” instead.
clip.needsService: This page can't be fetched from the browser on this deployment — it needs the research service (VITE_RESEARCH_ENDPOINT). Copy the part you want and use "Clip from clipboard".
collab.e2e.decryptFailed.body: The room password doesn't match the one the other participants used. Nothing was applied to your document — check the password and rejoin.
collab.e2e.emptyRoom: No one with this password is here yet
collab.e2e.emptyRoom.body: If you expected other people in this room, check the password — a wrong one looks like an empty room. Otherwise share your document to start the room.
collab.persistent.hint: Optional. Keeps documents synced when no peer is online.
collab.persistent.label: Persistent server (y-websocket)
collab.persistent.token: Server access token (if the server requires one)
collab.prompt.join: Join collaborative session "{room}"? Your current document will be replaced if other peers are present.
collab.role.comment: You can read and comment on this note, not change it.
collab.role.view: You can view this note. Changes and comments need a link with more access.
collab.settings.cspBlocked: This deployment's security policy blocks {url}, so it won't be used. Add it at build time (VITE_CSP_CONNECT_EXTRA).
collab.settings.publicSignaling.hint: yjs.dev and others — a fallback if Lumen's server is down. They can see who connects to which room (not the content).
collab.settings.signalingHint: Signaling server (how peers find each other). Empty = Lumen's own server. Every new room is end-to-end encrypted with its own password, so the server only sees ciphertext.
collab.settings.title: Collaboration settings

doc.alert.reopenFailed: Could not reopen file. The browser may have lost permission, or the file may have been moved.
doc.alert.workspaceUnavailable: Workspace storage isn't available in this browser.
doc.confirm.discardUnsaved: Discard unsaved changes and start a new document?
doc.history.quota: Version history is out of space even after removing the oldest versions.
doc.history.quotaWarn: Storage is {percent}% full. The oldest versions will be removed when it runs out.

doc.save.quota: The browser's storage for this site is full — “{name}” was not saved. Free space or export your notes.
git.alert.corsHint: The git host was not reached. In a browser it needs a CORS proxy: ⌘K → “Git: set CORS proxy…”.
git.alert.corsProxyBlocked: The app's security policy blocks {origin}. Use http://localhost:9999 or a proxy the deployment allows.
git.alert.corsProxyCleared: CORS proxy cleared: git connects directly.
git.alert.corsProxyInvalid: That is not an http(s) URL. Nothing was changed.

git.commit.lfsKept: Committed as the repository's Git LFS pointer, not as the file in the vault (LFS is not supported): {files}
git.commit.unresolved: Not committed: resolve the conflicts first: {files}
git.commit.unsaved: Not committed: these open notes have edits that could not be saved first (a change made outside Lumen is being resolved): {files}
git.conflict.body: Both sides changed the same lines. Until you choose, the file keeps both between markers.
git.conflict.left: {count} conflicts left, still marked in their files.
git.conflict.title: Git conflict — {path}
git.lfs.unsupported: Git LFS is not supported; these are LFS pointers: {files}
git.placeholder.name: Your name

git.pull.copies: Versions that could not be merged are kept as copies: {files}
git.pull.kindClashes: File/folder changed upstream, kept as is here: {files}
git.pull.mergedIntoOpen: Merged into open notes with unsaved edits (not overwritten): {files}

tree.linksFailed: Moved, but some links could not be updated: {error}

vault.boot.failed: Your notes can't be opened yet: part of Lumen didn't load (are you offline?).
vault.desktop.backedUp: A backup of the app's notes was saved to {path}.
vault.desktop.firstRunBody: Choose the folder where your notes live. Lumen keeps them there as plain Markdown files, so other apps such as Obsidian can open them too. Notes already in the app are backed up and copied there; nothing is deleted.
vault.export.folder: Into a folder on this computer
vault.folder.alreadyBrowser: The vault is already in browser storage.
vault.folder.conflict: Not moved: {n} files in “{folder}” already exist with different content (for example {path}). Nothing was changed.
vault.folder.failed: Moving the vault stopped: {error}. Nothing was deleted, and you can resume.
vault.folder.interrupted: Moving the vault to “{folder}” was interrupted. Nothing was deleted.
vault.folder.moved: The vault is now in the folder “{folder}”: {n} files copied and checked. Your notes in browser storage were not deleted.
vault.folder.movedBack: The vault is back in browser storage: {n} files copied and checked. The folder “{folder}” was not changed.
vault.folder.opened: Lumen now works in the folder “{folder}”. Notes in browser storage stay where they are.
vault.folder.permissionDenied: Lumen didn't get permission to edit the folder “{folder}”.
vault.folder.reconnectBody: Your vault is the folder “{folder}”. Lumen needs your permission to open it again.
vault.folder.unsupported: This browser can't open a folder on your computer, so your notes stay in the browser's private storage (OPFS). To keep the vault in a folder, use Chrome or Edge, or the desktop app.
versionHistory.noVersions: No versions yet. A version is kept every couple of minutes while you type, on every save and when you close the tab.
versionHistory.storage.notPersisted: Storage is not persistent: the browser may clear it when the disk is low.
versionHistory.storage.persisted: Storage is persistent: the browser won't clear it on its own.
versionHistory.storage.unsupported: This browser can't make storage persistent.
